Application Data.NAME: Sweet Sensations Bakery
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sweet Sensations Bakery specializes in crafting gourmet desserts, including cakes, pastries, and artisanal confections. We offer a curated selection of coffee and a limited range of dessert wine pairings, all served by trained staff adhering to responsible alcohol service policies. Our bakery maintains a clean and safe environment, complies with local health regulations, and continuously trains personnel in food safety practices. We are committed to providing an exceptional customer experience while minimizing risks associated with food safety and premises liability.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Sweet Indulgence Patisserie, 456 Dessert Lane, Springfield, IL 62701-5678
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a customer slipped and fell in the bakery due to a wet floor from spilled ingredients, resulting in a claim of $1,500. The claim was settled in 08/2022 with corrective measures implemented, including improved signage and increased staff training on cleaning protocols. Status: Closed. Additionally, on 09/10/2023, minor property damage occurred due to a kitchen appliance malfunction, amounting to $1,000. The equipment was repaired, and a maintenance schedule has been put in place. Status: Closed. Total losses: $2,500.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial Grade Safe, UL Class 350, Fire Resistant Label
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras, alarm system monitoring, and regular security patrols during off-hours.
